title: 缺乏便利性功能与生活质量改进
description: 游戏缺少快速操作、远程控制、自定义设置等便利性功能，影响操作效率和体验。
evidence: Your PDA could use some app to remote control stuff. We already have signal boxes, would be great to have ability to trigger them from PDA.
lack of quick options to do stuffs like undocking
Just unfinished, Zero quality of life

evidence_items.quote: Just unfinished, Zero quality of life
evidence_items.description: 游戏缺乏便利性功能，未完成
evidence_items.quote_zh: 就是没做完，零生活质量

evidence_items.quote: Scrolling your mouse skips along the pages so you don't even know if you have passed them already
evidence_items.description: 鼠标滚轮在社交应用列表中跳页，无法正常滚动
evidence_items.quote_zh: 滚动鼠标滚轮会在页面间跳跃，所以你甚至不知道自己是不是已经翻过他们了

evidence_items.quote: Your PDA could use some app to remote control stuff. We already have signal boxes, would be great to have ability to trigger them from PDA.
evidence_items.description: PDA缺少远程控制功能，无法触发信号盒或访问导航站
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你的PDA可以加一些远程控制东西的应用。我们已经有信号盒了，能从PDA触发它们会很好。

evidence_items.quote: LACKING QOL
evidence_items.description: 飞船设计缺乏生活质量功能，如无法导入设计、没有规划模式、黑暗影响建造等
evidence_items.quote_zh: 缺乏生活质量改进

evidence_items.quote: Also, if you want us to engage with orbital mechanics, at least give us a propper maneuver palnner Kerbal space programm came out 11 years ago ffs.
evidence_items.description: 缺少合适的机动规划器
evidence_items.quote_zh: 另外，如果你想让我们认真对待轨道力学，至少给我们一个像样的机动规划器吧，坎巴拉太空计划11年前就出了，靠。

evidence_items.quote: Digging around for that one item stashed away somewhere in a bag inside of a bag is not fun.
evidence_items.description: 在层层嵌套的背包中翻找物品很麻烦
evidence_items.quote_zh: 为了找那件藏在包里套包里的某样东西而翻来翻去，一点都不好玩。

evidence_items.quote: Let's hope the devs improve the UX
evidence_items.description: 用户体验有待改进
evidence_items.quote_zh: 希望开发者能改进用户体验

evidence_items.quote: poor QoL
evidence_items.description: 生活质量功能较差
evidence_items.quote_zh: 糟糕的生活质量

evidence_items.quote: both on performance and user experience issues
evidence_items.description: 用户体验存在问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 性能和用户体验两方面都有问题

evidence_items.quote: K-Leg has  a couple of different zones and I don't understand why that's needed/ it just introduces annoying loading screens
evidence_items.description: K-Leg站分为多个区域，引入不必要的加载画面
evidence_items.quote_zh: K-Leg有几个不同的区域，我不明白为什么需要这样/它只是引入了烦人的加载画面

evidence_items.quote: Добавили QOL фичи, меньше ебки с инвентарем, стало удобнее перемещать вещи.
evidence_items.description: 库存管理得到改善，移动物品更方便
evidence_items.quote_zh: 添加了QOL功能，物品栏的操蛋事少了，移动东西变得更方便了。

evidence_items.quote: 因为角色AI跟操作UI都是顶配的糟糕导致实际玩下来游戏内时间跟现实时间差不多是1:1流逝的
evidence_items.description: 角色AI和操作UI糟糕导致游戏内时间流逝缓慢
evidence_items.quote_zh: 因为角色AI跟操作UI都是顶配的糟糕导致实际玩下来游戏内时间跟现实时间差不多是1:1流逝的

evidence_items.quote: a bit of QoL and performance fixes would be appreciated
evidence_items.description: 需要一些生活质量改进
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果能有一些生活质量改进和性能修复就好了

evidence_items.quote: make loading from the menu possible
evidence_items.description: 无法从菜单直接加载游戏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 让从菜单加载成为可能

evidence_items.quote: 做完事情不能回調到初始的一倍嗎？
evidence_items.description: 时间流速调整后无法恢复初始速度
evidence_items.quote_zh: 做完事情不能回調到初始的一倍嗎？

evidence_items.quote: 每次esc就重置位置
evidence_items.description: 按ESC后物品栏位置重置，需要重新寻找
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每次esc就重置位置

evidence_items.quote: With every action, it either closes all the windows, which resets its position, or opens you're inventory.
evidence_items.description: 每次操作都会关闭所有窗口并重置位置
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每一次操作，它要么关闭所有窗口，从而重置其位置，要么打开你的物品栏。

evidence_items.quote: requiring the game to be unpaused to look at your items is not good
evidence_items.description: 查看容器物品需要交互并选择inventory，且游戏必须取消暂停，检查每个物品栏很繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 要求游戏取消暂停才能查看你的物品，这不好

evidence_items.quote: cycling through each option instead of say, a dropdown menu or even just having a name tied to each option
evidence_items.description: 角色创建需逐个循环选项而非下拉菜单
evidence_items.quote_zh: 循环切换每个选项，而不是比如说下拉菜单，甚至只是给每个选项配个名字

evidence_items.quote: although there is a speed up time function, the game typically crawls at 1 second per second
evidence_items.description: 加速时间功能不足，睡眠等动作仍需大量现实时间
evidence_items.quote_zh: 尽管有一个加速时间的功能，游戏通常还是以每秒一秒的速度缓慢爬行

evidence_items.quote: The only issue I am running into is how to cancel a task.
evidence_items.description: 无法取消任务
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我唯一遇到的问题是如何取消一个任务。

evidence_items.quote: The UI still needs some improvements - mostly the status bar
evidence_items.description: 状态栏仍需改进
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI仍然需要一些改进——主要是状态栏

evidence_items.quote: lack of quick options to do stuffs like undocking
evidence_items.description: 缺少快速操作选项，如解除对接
evidence_items.quote_zh: 缺少像解除对接这样的快捷操作选项

evidence_items.quote: overlays not closing
evidence_items.description: GUI覆盖层无法关闭
evidence_items.quote_zh: 覆盖层无法关闭

evidence_items.quote: overlays not closing
evidence_items.description: GUI覆盖层无法关闭
evidence_items.quote_zh: 覆盖层无法关闭

player_themes.title: K-Leg站分为多个区域，引入不必要的加载画面

evidence_items.quote: K-Leg has  a couple of different zones and I don't understand why that's needed/ it just introduces annoying loading screens
evidence_items.description: K-Leg站分为多个区域，引入不必要的加载画面
evidence_items.quote_zh: K-Leg有几个不同的区域，我不明白为什么需要这样/它只是引入了烦人的加载画面

player_themes.title: PDA缺少远程控制功能，无法触发信号盒或访问导航站

evidence_items.quote: Your PDA could use some app to remote control stuff. We already have signal boxes, would be great to have ability to trigger them from PDA.
evidence_items.description: PDA缺少远程控制功能，无法触发信号盒或访问导航站
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你的PDA可以加一些远程控制东西的应用。我们已经有信号盒了，能从PDA触发它们会很好。
